memory.text: 12.22 GiB of mapped files stay in RAM during decode. These pages are reclaimable page cache, not a leak, but they are why a later run loads fast and why the machine shows little free RAM.
Host memory grew 191 MiB during decode, from 3.38 GiB to 3.57 GiB. If it keeps growing with more requests it is a leak or an unbounded cache; if it levels off, a cache filling up.

movement.text: The model is on hdd storage (<path>/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-Q8_0-upstream.gguf). This run did not read it from disk; --cold-start measures what a first load costs.
The model was 100% in the page cache, so this load time is a warm one. A cold start reads it from disk and takes longer.

0.07 GiB written to disk during decode: a cache being offloaded to disk, or logging. Either way those writes share the disk with any reads the engine needs.
